resources.string: Without \"All files access\" the game cannot read the ISO. Close the app and open it again to grant it
Without storage access the game cannot open the ISO
Choose it from the phone storage or an SD card (Files, not an app or cloud folder)

The game reads the ISO straight from the phone storage and keeps its data in the \"NFSMW Recompiled\" folder. For that Android asks for \"All files access\".\n\nAndroid restarts the app when it is granted: open it again afterwards.
